findings: Arieh Tal whole stem and leaves, Glen Mittelhauser spikelets: straight upright culms with narrow bending nodal leaves; old single fan rejected. Spring vegetative form omits mature cylindrical head. Current three-size pilots (seeds 1,4,7) and every panel of36-seed contact sheet visually reviewed. More open basal foliage and narrow nodal leaves on upright culms; 35–75 cm. Spike heads intentionally absent in chosen spring vegetative state. Individual sheath/ligule features are unresolved. Accepted as stylized spring source; variant endorsement remains a user decision.
